name: nopbooster-store-assistant
description: Run your nopCommerce store from Claude: sales reports, stuck orders, catalogue and SEO audits, translations and bulk price updates, with every change previewed for your approval. Requires the MCP Server (Booster AI) plugin on your store.

store_url.title: Store address
store_url.description: Your nopCommerce store's public address, starting with https:// and without a trailing slash, e.g. https://www.example.com

api_key.title: Booster AI API key
api_key.description: An admin API key created under MCP Server > API keys in your nopCommerce admin. Start with read-only scopes.
